data.name: [MAJOR UPDATE] Zone STALKER [Pre Alpha]
data.description:
Enter the Zone.

Zone STALKER is a hardcore atmospheric extraction survival game inspired by the legendary STALKER series. Scavenge abandoned industrial ruins, survive deadly anomalies, hunt mutants, and fight hostile factions across a dangerous open world consumed by the Zone.

Every expedition is a risk. Build your loadout, manage your supplies, complete tasks, and extract with your loot before the Zone takes everything from you.

Travel alone or with up to 4 players in online co-op through dark forests, abandoned checkpoints, underground facilities, and radioactive wastelands where every gunshot echoes danger.

Features:
• Persistent character saving & progression
• Personal stash system
• Hardcore loot loss & extraction gameplay
• Dynamic anomalies, emissions, and atmospheric events
• AI factions, mutants, and random encounters
• Randomly generated Task.
• Detailed inventory & gear management system
• Squad-based co-op survival

(PRE-ALPHA) Expect bugs, wipes, and missing features!

data.name: Revenant Protocol: ZOMBIES
data.description:
⚠️ This game is in its DEMO phase. Expect limited features and content, bugs, unfinished systems, and frequent changes. ⚠️

REVENANT PROTOCOL is a round-based zombie survival game with a focus on grounded combat and oppressive atmosphere. Weapons are scarce, ammunition matters, and no run is guaranteed to unfold the same way. As the rounds climb, the game becomes less forgiving and survival starts to depend on how well you can handle the pressure.

※Currently Supports:
▣ PC ☑
▣ Mobile ☑
▣ Console ☑

The game is designed with higher graphics settings in mind and is best experienced with them enabled. Lower graphics settings are fully supported for players on less powerful devices, though some of the intended visual atmosphere and detail may be reduced.

💚 Thank you for playing REVENANT PROTOCOL! Your support and feedback help us improve the game.

PC

Mobile

⚙️ Normal, Hard and Nightmare raids, up to 12 survivors per raid, pure PvE

Stay quiet. Get out.
